Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:1.hebrew: דאיברו ביה דגים ועופות - שאין טורחין לאוכלין, אלא ניזונים בחסדו של הקב"ה:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:1.english: Because fish and fowl were created on it - For they do not toil for [their] food; rather, they are sustained by the kindness of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:2.english: A seeker - [One who] goes around seeking mitzvot.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:3.hebrew: חזרן במצות - שכן דרך ע"ש לחזר אחר מצות שבת:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:3.english: A seeker of mitzvot - For such is the way of Shabbat eve, to go about seeking Shabbat mitzvot.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:4.hebrew: וקדישא רבה יתקרי - שיהא פרוש וקדוש, דכתיב (שמות כ) ויקדשהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:10:4.english: And he will be called a great holy one - [Meaning] that he will be abstinent and holy, as it is written (Exodus 20): "and He sanctified it."

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:1.hebrew: אמר להו רבי חנינא - לתלמידים שקראו פנקסו של ר' יהושע:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:1.english: Rabbi Ḥanina said to them - To the students who read Rabbi Yehoshua's notebook.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:10.english: Builds and destroys - Like this moon, which waxes and wanes.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:11.english: He eats [what is] not his - Like the moon, which encroaches upon the boundary of the sun to rule even by day.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:12.english: And his secrets are hidden - Like the moon, which does not shine.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:13.english: Under Saturn - [The] constellation of a star whose name is Shabbetai [Saturn].

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:14.english: Are for naught - [Connecting Shabbetai (Saturn) to cessation,] as in, "shall not cease [lo yishbotu]" (Genesis 8).

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:15.hebrew: צדקן במצות - צדקה לעניים, דקרי ליה מצוה (בכל) לשון אגדה:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:15.english: Just in mitzvot - Charity to the poor, for [charity] is called "mitzvah" in (all) the language of Aggadah.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:16.english: A thief - A bandit who kills people.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:18.english: Punishes - people who transgress his words.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:2.hebrew: מזל שעה - ז' מזלות הן המשמשין את השעות: חנכ"ל שצ"ם. חמה היינו חמה ממש, והוא אחד מן המזלות, וכן לבנה, והשאר הוויין כוכבים:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:2.english: The constellation of the hour - [There are] seven celestial bodies that serve the hours: Chanakal Shatzam [Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars]. Chammah is the actual sun, and it is one of the [seven] celestial bodies, and likewise the moon, and the rest are stars.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:4.english: He eats from his own - Like the sun, which does not encroach upon its fellow's boundary to rule at night.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:5.hebrew: ורזוהי גליין - אין לו רשות לכסות סודו ונסתרותיו, אלא כשמש הזה שהוא פומבי לכל:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:5.english: And his secrets will be exposed - He does not have the ability to conceal his secret and his hidden [matters]; rather, [he is] like this sun, which is open to all.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:7.hebrew: דתלי ביה נורא - אש תלוי באותו מזל, יצר של תשמיש בוער כתנור:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:7.english: For fire is suspended in it - Fire is suspended in that constellation; the inclination for intercourse burns like an oven.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:8.hebrew: מזל כוכב - הוא סופר של מזל חמה, לכתוב דרך הילוכו ותקופותיו, ומצוי אצלו תמיד:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:8.english: The planet Mercury - It is the scribe of the planet of the sun, to record the path of its course and its seasons, and is always found with it.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:11:9.english: Suffers illnesses - Like this moon, which progressively wanes.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:12:1.hebrew: מזל מחכים - לפי המזל היא החכמה, כדאמר דבחמה נהיר וחכים. ויש מזל לישראל, שאין תפלה וצדקה משנה את המזל:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:12:1.english: A constellation makes one wise - Wisdom is according to the constellation, as [was] stated, that [one born] under the sun is bright and wise. And there is a constellation for Israel, for prayer and charity do not change the constellation.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:12:2.english: There is no constellation for Israel - For through prayer and merit, one's constellation is changed for the good.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:14:2.hebrew: צא מאיצטגנינותיך - היינו דכתיב "ויוצא אותו החוצה", חוץ מאיצטגנוניתו:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:14:2.english: Emerge from your astrology - This is what is written: "And He brought him outside" — outside of his astrology.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:1:1.hebrew: רבי יוסי בר יהודה היא - (דאי רבי, לא מהני ליה שינוי, דמנתינת מים מיחייב, אפילו במידי דלאו בר גיבול, כדאמרינן גבי מורסן; אבל לרבי יוסי בר יהודה) דאמר עד שיגבל, הכא גובלין כלאחר יד, כדמפרש ואזיל, והנ"מ הוא דקא משני:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:1:1.english: It is [the opinion of] Rabbi Yosei bar Yehuda - (For if [it were] Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], an alteration would not avail him, since one is liable from the pouring of water [alone], even with something that is not subject to kneading, as we said regarding bran; whereas according to Rabbi Yosei bar Yehuda) who says [one is not liable] until he kneads, here one kneads in an unusual manner, as [the Gemara] goes on to explain: "And this applies only where one alters [the manner of kneading]."

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:2:1.english: That one may mix - With a ladle, which is [the same as] kneading.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:2:2.hebrew: ושותים זיתום המצרי - דבלאו רפואה נמי משקה הוא, דתנן: "כל המשקין שותה אדם לרפואה" (לעיל שבת דף קט:):
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:2:2.english: And drink Egyptian beer - For even without [being for] healing, it is also a beverage, as we learned in a Mishnah: "A person may drink any beverages for healing" (above, Shabbat 109b).

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:2:3.hebrew: בעבה - אין גובלין; ברכה בוחשין, שאין זו לישה:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:2:3.english: With a thick [mixture] - one may not knead; with a soft [mixture], one may stir, for this is not [considered] kneading.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:1.hebrew: בחול נותן החומץ כו' - כלומר, כן דרכו בחול:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:1.english: On a weekday one places the vinegar, etc. - That is to say, such is his [usual] way on a weekday.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:2.english: The kneader of his household - The keeper of his father's animals, who kneads their food.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:3.hebrew: דקא גביל - מורסן ע"י שינוי:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:3.english: Who was kneading - bran, through an alteration [in the usual manner].

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:4.hebrew: בטש ביה - דהא לכולי עלמא, "אבל לא גובלין" תנן:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:4.english: He kicked him - For according to everyone, we learned [in the Mishnah]: "but one may not knead."

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:5.hebrew: גובלין - מורסן ע"י שינוי, כדמפרש ואזיל והוא דקא משני:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:5.english: One may knead - bran through an alteration [in the usual manner], as [the Gemara] goes on to explain, "and provided that one alters [the manner]."

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:6.english: And [one may] not feed - [that is,] to oxen; one does not force-feed them.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:7.english: And [one] that does not pick up [food] with its tongue - [This refers to] a young calf that has not yet learned to eat.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:3:8.english: And this applies - [to what] we said, that it is permitted to knead bran.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:4:1.english: Warp and woof - Once he moves the stick [in the direction of] warp, and once [in the direction of] woof.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:4:2.english: One pours it into a vessel - And it mixes by itself.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:1.english: In his notebook - Tablets bound together with one another, like those of merchants.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:2.english: I said before Rabbi - Rabbi Levi is relating that he said before Rabbi regarding those people who knead shetita [a gruel of parched grain].

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:3.english: What is [the ruling regarding] emptying - To take [food] from within a vessel that is before this animal and place [it] before its fellow.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:4.hebrew: חדא קמי חדא - מילתא באפי נפשה היא. חדא מדה שרגילין לתת לפני בהמה מותר לתת לפניה בשבת, וכן תרתי קמי תרתי האוכלות באבוס אחד:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:4.english: One before one - This is an independent statement. One measure that they are accustomed to place before an animal is permitted to be placed before it on Shabbat, and similarly two [measures] before two [animals] that eat from one trough.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:5.hebrew: אבל תלתא קמי תרתי - הואיל ובחול לא יהיב להו כי האי, הוי טרחא דלא צריך, וכ"ש תרתי קמי חדא:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:5:5.english: But three [measures] before two [animals] - Since on a weekday one does not give them such [an amount], it is unnecessary exertion, and all the more so two [measures] before one [animal].

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:6:1.hebrew: מדר' יוסי בר יהודה - בר פלוגתיה, דהוה שרי לעיל אף בעבה ועל ידי שינוי, והיו נוהגין כמותו:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:6:1.english: Due to Rabbi Yosei bar Yehuda - [He was] his disputant, who permitted above even [making it] thick and with a variation, and they would act in accordance with him.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:7:1.english: One who [is] on the first day of the week - One who was born on the first day of the week [Sunday].

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:7:2.hebrew: יהא גבר ולא חדא ביה - יהא אדם שלם, במדה אחת יהא, ולא אחת בו ממדה אחרת. ולקמן מפרש לה ואזיל:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:7:2.english: He will be a person and there will not be one in him - He will be a complete person: he will be [wholly] in one trait, and there will not be one [part] in him of another trait. And below, [the Gemara] proceeds to explain it.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:8:1.hebrew: והוא ריש גנבי - דמאן דבחד בשבא יהא ראש, כמו שהיום ראש למעשה בראשית. מיהו, שמע מינה דנולדים בו צדיקים ורשעים:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:8:1.english: And he [was] the head of thieves - For whoever [is born] on the first day of the week will be a leader, just as that day is the head of the work of Creation. However, learn from this that [both] righteous and wicked [people] are born on it.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:9:1.english: [Because] the waters were divided - So [too], he will be separated from every person.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:9:3.hebrew: דאיברו ביה עשבים - דכתי' (בראשי' א) "תדשא הארץ", והוא דבר שפרה ורבה מאד וממהר לגדל ולצמוח, דהוא ענין פריצות — אשווי"א בלע"ז. [ל"א] דלא כתיב "למינהו" בעשבים בצוויים, (ועוד) שיוצאין בערבוביא ויונקין זו מזו:
Rashi on Shabbat 156a:9:3.english: Because vegetation was created on that day - As it is written (Genesis 1[:11]): "Let the earth sprout forth [grass]," and [vegetation] is something that is exceedingly fruitful and multiplies, and hastens to grow and sprout, which is a matter of unrestrained proliferation (*esvoie* in Old French). [Another explanation:] because "after its kind" is not written regarding grasses in their command [of Creation], (and furthermore,) because they emerge in a jumble and draw nourishment from one another.

Rashi on Shabbat 156a:9:5.english: That the lights were hung on it - And it is written, "And Torah is light."

Tosafot on Shabbat 156a:12:1.hebrew: אין מזל לישראל - והא דאמר רבא בשילהי מו"ק (דף כח. ושם): "בני, חיי, ומזוני לאו בזכותא תליא מילתא, אלא במזלא תליא מילתא" — מכל מקום על ידי זכות גדול משתנה, אבל פעמים שאין המזל משתנה, כדאמר ביבמות פרק החולץ (יבמות דף נ. ושם): "זכה — מוסיפין לו; לא זכה — פוחתין לו" (דאין מזל לישראל):
Tosafot on Shabbat 156a:12:1.english: "There is no constellation for the Jewish people" - And [as for] that which Rava said at the end of Moed Katan (28a, and there): "Children, life, and sustenance do not depend on merit, rather they depend on constellation" — nevertheless, through great merit it changes, whereas sometimes the constellation does not change, as it says in Yevamot, chapter HaCholetz (Yevamot 50a, and there): "[If] he merits, they add [years] to him; [if] he does not merit, they subtract [years] from him" (since there is no constellation for the Jewish people).

Tosafot on Shabbat 156a:5:1.hebrew: מהו לפרק - פירש בקונטרס: לפרק מלפני בהמה זו וליתן לפני אחרת, וכן פירש בערוך בערך פרק. וקשה לר"י, דהיינו מתניתין גבי בהמה (לעיל שבת דף קמ:). ונראה לר"י: לפרק — היינו להריק המים וגם המורסן מכלי אל כלי, שתגבל היטב; ובערוך פירש כמה לשונות:
Tosafot on Shabbat 156a:5:1.english: What is [the ruling] regarding lefarek? - Rashi explained: to remove [food] from before this animal and place [it] before another, and so the Arukh explained under the entry perek. And this is difficult for the Ri, for that is [already taught in] the Mishnah regarding an animal (above, Shabbat 140b). And it appears to the Ri [that] lefarek means to pour the water and also the bran from vessel to vessel, so that it will be kneaded well; and in the Arukh he explained several interpretations.
